description: OLG retrieval benchmark v2 — covers SNAP/TAFDC/EAEDC/Cross-Program/BP/Verification Chart, mixed difficulty, includes adversarial cases for hybrid/rerank testing

matching.notes: OLG has no numeric section identifier like CMR. expected_chunk_id is informational only; metrics come from LLM judge labels.

questions.question: A client applies for SNAP with their two children. They provide an SSN for themselves and the oldest child, but the second, a newborn, does not have an SSN yet. All are US citizens. How do I process the case without the child's SSN?
questions.notes: SSN policy — applicants without SSN, newborn carve-out, BEACON entry. Procedural lookup.

questions.question: What are the standard requirements to verify that a client is homeless?
questions.notes: Verification list for homeless status. Should pull SNAP eligibility / shelter pages.

questions.question: What kind of expenses are self-employed clients able to claim for their income?
questions.notes: Self-employment cost-of-doing-business deduction. Specific allowable/non-allowable expenses.

questions.question: What eligibility requirements are there for clients who specifically are college students?
questions.notes: SNAP student rules — half-time enrollment threshold, exemption list (work hours, dependent care, work-study, etc.).

questions.question: What non-citizenship designations are excluded from SNAP?
questions.notes: Multi-section topic — qualified vs non-qualified non-citizens, ineligible statuses, sponsored aliens.

questions.question: How is income counted for someone who rents out a room in their house?
questions.notes: Boarder/roomer income treatment — net vs gross, household composition implications.

questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum amounts of medical expenses that a client can claim?
questions.notes: Medical expense deduction for elderly/disabled — $35 min, standard medical deduction amount, threshold for itemizing. Numeric lookup.

questions.question: Dependent care deduction — what counts?
questions.notes: Allowable dependent care costs — child care, transportation to care, before/after school, etc.

questions.question: How are lump sum payments treated when entering income for a client?
questions.notes: Lump sum classification — countable vs excluded, which lump sums count as income vs asset.

questions.question: TAFDC 24-month time limit clock — what counts, exemptions
questions.notes: Multi-section — clock-counting rules, hardship exemptions, extensions, good cause.

questions.question: What are the ESP participation requirements?
questions.notes: Employment Services Program — participation hours, activity types, sanction process.

questions.question: What is considered to be a good cause reason for non-cooperation with child support requirements?
questions.notes: Specific list of good cause reasons — DV, rape, fear of harm, adoption pending, child conceived from rape/incest.

questions.question: What eligibility requirements exist for teen / young parents?
questions.notes: Teen/minor parent — living arrangement requirement, school attendance, adult-supervised housing.

questions.question: What is the EAEDC disability standard and how do we verify?
questions.notes: Disability definition + DET process + medical verification requirements.

questions.question: What is considered EAEDC categorical eligibility?
questions.notes: Categorical groups — age 65+, disabled, caretaker of disabled, participating in MRC/MCB, etc.

questions.question: What are the application processing timeliness standards?
questions.notes: 30-day standard, 7-day expedited, time clock start. Cross-program — no filter.

questions.question: What are some acceptable verifications for residency?
questions.notes: VERIFICATION CHART TEST — should hit the manually-overridden topical chunks (12, not 32 alphabetical). Regression check on Q35-style retrieval.

questions.question: What are the fair hearing rights and timeframes?
questions.notes: BP material — rights to hearing, request timeframe, scheduling, decision timeframe. Cross-program.

questions.question: What is the difference between IPV, UPV, and AE overpayments?
questions.notes: Three-way distinction — Intentional Program Violation, Unintentional Program Violation, Agency Error. Should pull BP/Cross-Program overpayment pages.

questions.question: What special actions must be taken when a client discloses that they are victims of domestic violence and want to receive support from a DV specialist?
questions.notes: DV protections — confidentiality, address suppression, DV specialist referral, waivers from cooperation requirements. Cross-program.

questions.question: ABAWD
questions.notes: ADVERSARIAL — bare acronym. Tests whether retrieval surfaces the ABAWD work-requirement pages from a single rare token. Expected to be a hybrid-search win.

questions.question: VC-1
questions.notes: ADVERSARIAL — form code. VC-1 is the verification request form. Tests rare-token retrieval. Should pull Verification Chart and form-related pages.

questions.question: ESP exemptions
questions.notes: ADVERSARIAL — acronym + topic. Tests retrieval on TAFDC ESP exemption list when query is terse. No filter to test raw retrieval.

questions.question: expedited 7 day
questions.notes: ADVERSARIAL — terse numeric+concept. Should pull SNAP expedited pages despite minimal query. Tests dense retrieval on numeric tokens.
